classification.difficultyReason: Construct reference triangles, calculate missing sides and select signs using angle restrictions.

content.prompt: For each question, draw a right-angled triangle using the given ratio, determine the quadrant(s), then find the new ratio.

answer.worked:
The reference triangle has adjacent side $1$ and hypotenuse $3$.
$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Opp}&=\sqrt{3^2-1^2}\\&=\sqrt8\\&=2\sqrt2\end{aligned}$$
An acute angle is in quadrant I, where tangent is positive.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan\theta&=\frac{\mathrm{Opp}}{\mathrm{Adj}}\\&=\frac{2\sqrt2}{1}\\&=2\sqrt2\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked:
The reference triangle has adjacent side $1$ and hypotenuse $2$.
$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Opp}&=\sqrt{2^2-1^2}\\&=\sqrt3\end{aligned}$$
A reflex angle with positive cosine is in quadrant IV, where sine is negative.
$$\sin\theta=-\frac{\mathrm{Opp}}{\mathrm{Hyp}}=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$$

answer.worked:
The reference triangle has opposite side $2$ and adjacent side $3$.
$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Hyp}&=\sqrt{3^2+2^2}\\&=\sqrt{13}\end{aligned}$$
A reflex angle with negative tangent is in quadrant IV, where cosine is positive.
$$\cos\theta=\frac{\mathrm{Adj}}{\mathrm{Hyp}}=\frac3{\sqrt{13}}$$

$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Opp}&=\sqrt{41^2-40^2}\\&=\sqrt{81}\\&=9\end{aligned}$$

$$\sin\theta=\frac{\mathrm{Opp}}{\mathrm{Hyp}}=\frac9{41}$$

answer.worked:
The reference triangle has opposite side $1$ and hypotenuse $\sqrt5$.
$$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{Adj}&=\sqrt{(\sqrt5)^2-1^2}\\&=\sqrt4\\&=2\end{aligned}$$
